name: Not According To Concepts
source:
This novel is dedicated to the adventures of a young streamer and his friend. The characters face both the most mundane, everyday challenges and the more unusual ones.

[Translated from [url=https://nayloft-games.itch.io/natc]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这本小说讲述了一位年轻的主播和他的朋友的冒险经历。这些角色面临着最平凡的日常挑战和更不寻常的挑战。
